description: This Java class handles 'CREATE' commands for hooks in the Fineract infrastructure, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and invoking HookWritePlatformService to create hooks within a transactional context.

classes.name: CreateHookCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles 'CREATE' commands for hooks, processes commands to create hooks via HookWritePlatformService, and is annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to create a hook by delegating to the writePlatformService's createHook method within a transactional context.
